description: NaC₃N₃H₄O₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one NaC₃N₃H₄O₄ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.53 Å. There are three inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two N and one O atom. There is one shorter (1.34 Å) and one longer (1.40 Å) C-N bond length. The C-O bond length is 1.25 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two N and one O atom. There is one shorter (1.34 Å) and one longer (1.39 Å) C-N bond length. The C-O bond length is 1.25 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two N and one O atom. Both C-N bond lengths are 1.36 Å. The C-O bond length is 1.24 Å. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two C and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.04 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two C atoms. In the third N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two C and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.03 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one N atom. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms.
